title: RNA polymerase sliding on DNA can couple the transcription of nearby bacterial operons.
authors: Tenenbaum, Debora; Inlow, Koe; Friedman, Larry J; Cai, Anthony; Gelles, Jeff; Kondev, Jane
journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America
one_liner_zh: 该文通过数学建模和单分子实验研究RNA聚合酶在DNA上滑动介导邻近操纵子转录偶联的机制，属于广义蛋白质-DNA互作与动态结合机理研究，但对象为RNA聚合酶而非典型TF-DNA体系，方法以理论建模和实验为主，AI/物理模拟深度有限，对本课题有借鉴价值。
abstract: DNA transcription initiates after an RNA polymerase (RNAP) molecule binds to the promoter of a gene. In bacteria, the canonical picture is that RNAP comes from the cytoplasmic pool of freely diffusing RNAP molecules. Recent experiments suggest the possible existence of a separate pool of polymerases, competent for initiation, which freely slide on the DNA after having terminated one round of transcription. Promoter-dependent transcription reinitiation from this pool of posttermination RNAP may lead to coupled initiation at nearby operons, but it is unclear whether this can occur over the distance and timescales needed for it to function widely on a bacterial genome in vivo. Here, we mathematically model the hypothesized reinitiation mechanism as a diffusion-to-capture process and compute the distances over which significant interoperon coupling can occur and the time required. These quantities depend on molecular association and dissociation rate constants between DNA, RNAP, and the transcription initiation factor sigma(70); we measure these rate constants using single-molecule experiments in vitro. Our combined theory/experimental results demonstrate that efficient coupling can occur at physiologically relevant sigma(70) concentrations and on timescales appropriate for transcript synthesis. Coupling is efficient over terminator-promoter distances up to  approximately 1,000 bp, which includes the majority of terminator-promoter nearest neighbor pairs in the Escherichia coli genome. The results suggest a generalized mechanism that couples the transcription of nearby operons and breaks the paradigm that each binding of RNAP to DNA can produce at most one messenger RNA.
abstract_zh: DNA转录在RNA聚合酶（RNAP）分子结合到基因启动子后启动。在细菌中，经典观点认为RNAP来自细胞质中自由扩散的RNAP分子库。最近的实验表明，可能存在一个独立的聚合酶库，这些聚合酶具备起始能力，并在完成一轮转录后自由地在DNA上滑动。来自这个终止后RNAP库的启动子依赖性转录再起始可能导致邻近操纵子的偶联起始，但尚不清楚这是否能在体内细菌基因组上广泛发挥作用的距离和时间尺度上发生。在此，我们通过数学模型将假设的再起始机制描述为扩散捕获过程，并计算了显著的操纵子间偶联可能发生的距离及所需时间。这些量取决于DNA、RNAP和转录起始因子sigma(70)之间的分子结合和解离速率常数；我们通过体外单分子实验测量了这些速率常数。我们的理论与实验结合结果表明，在生理相关的sigma(70)浓度下，偶联可以高效发生，且时间尺度适合转录合成。偶联在终止子-启动子距离高达约1,000 bp时高效，这包括了大肠杆菌基因组中大多数终止子-启动子最近邻对。这些结果提出了一种通用机制，该机制偶联邻近操纵子的转录，并打破了RNAP每次结合DNA最多只能产生一个信使RNA的范式。
